title: iguanura humilis
intro: Iguanura humilis, commonly known as the wild betel nut palm, is a species of palm tree native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Iguanura humilis include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
